newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended firm after the Swiss National Bank left the discount rate steady at 1.00 percent, as most market players had expected.
"There were no surprises," one Swiss-based trader said. "The long end is not performing today, which is not surprising because the spread to Bunds is so big."

With the SNB keeping the money market awash in liquidity to counter any Swiss franc strength, the yield curve remains very steep, he said. "The value is still at the long end. I think there will be a consolidation and then we will go up again."
"The market has to rest a bit and then it will go further," he added, noting a dearth of quality paper at the long end of the market.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 25 at 112.25
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up 4 at 98.70.
